description: Implementation of a video decoder using FFmpeg, including buffer management, decoding, and frame processing for the 'FFMPEG' specialization.

classes.name: VideoDecoderImpl<FFMPEG>
classes.description: FFmpeg-based video decoder implementation with buffer management, decoding, and frame processing.

methods.name: AllocateBuffer
methods.description: Allocates buffers for video frames, supporting different FFmpeg API versions.

methods.name: ProcessDecodedFrame
methods.description: Processes a decoded AVFrame into a CpuVideoFrame and updates the decode target if needed.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Initializes the FFmpeg codec context and allocates necessary resources.

methods.name: TeardownCodec
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the FFmpeg codec context.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decoded video frame as a decode target for rendering.

methods.name: DecodePacket
methods.description: Decodes an AVPacket into frames, handling different FFmpeg API versions.

methods.name: DecoderThreadFunc
methods.description: Main decoding thread loop, processing input buffers and end-of-stream signals.
